affinity.notes: The identity is physical and biological, with no clear elemental treatment.

anatomy.notes: Shoulder growths and embedded figures merge into the torso, making the upper-body structure difficult to parse.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "regenerating melee brute" does not semantically communicate Misgrowth-Choice Controller (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Exposed swollen growths and an unarmed heavy stance imply weak fleshy targets and close-range pressure.

finish.notes: Wet flesh, scars, hide, and grime are consistently rendered.

framing.notes: The entire lumbering body is centered with a readable outer silhouette.

identity.notes: Blind perception "mutated troll or flesh giant" does not semantically identify exact mapped form trolls/troll-mutant-troll.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "elite" is accepted for intended T3 under the documented v2 normalization.
